_doc: Hand-edit this freely. Field meanings: docs/searches.schema.md

location.note: Uses whatever location your Marketplace is already set to. Change mode to 'explicit' and add a 'place' value to pin it instead.

searches.label: Complete golf sets

must_have.test: Right-handed. Reject explicit 'left handed', 'LH', 'lefty'. Unstated = assume RH (it's the default) but note the assumption.
Regular flex shafts. Sellers usually omit flex — unstated is a maybe, not a reject. Explicit 'stiff'/'X-stiff' only = downgrade, not eliminate.
Irons spanning roughly 5-PW or better. A 'set' with only a few irons is a picked-over bundle — reject.

nice_to_have.test: Includes a stand or cart bag.
Callaway, TaylorMade, Titleist, Ping, Mizuno, Cobra.

dealbreakers: Women's flex sets (unless you say otherwise)
Single clubs or partial bundles dressed up as a 'set'

condition.note: Cosmetic wear, scratches and worn grips are fine if playable. Grooves should not be worn smooth.

fair_value.basis: Marketplace/eBay asking prices for used complete sets, Jul 2026. Not sold-comps yet — Phase 3 replaces these.

searches.label: Pokémon Elite Trainer Boxes (sealed)

must_have.test: Factory sealed, shrink-wrap intact. Reject 'opened', 'no packs', 'empty box', 'accessories only'. Verify against photos, not just the title — resealed and 'like new opened' are common.
An actual Elite Trainer Box — not a booster bundle, tin, collection box, or single blister.

nice_to_have.test: Out-of-print set. Where the real mispricings are — sellers clearing storage often price at old retail.
Several ETBs together often price below per-box market.
Pokémon Center exclusive versions carry a premium over standard.

dealbreakers: Booster bundles or tins mislabeled as ETBs
Obvious counterfeit signals (wrong logo, off-color packaging, bulk 'wholesale' pricing)

condition.note: Sealed only. Box dings and shelf wear are acceptable — the seal is what matters.

fair_value.basis: MSRP anchors only. PriceCharting blocks plain HTTP fetching (403), so Phase 3 must pull comps through the browser instead — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

set_overrides._comment: Retired sets vary enormously and need real comps. These are rough placeholders — correct them as you learn.

searches.label: Powered bookshelf speakers for turntable

must_have.test: Has a PHONO input / built-in phono stage. Your turntable has no preamp, so line-level-only speakers will not work. Verify from the model, not the seller's wording — most powered speakers are line-level only.
Sold as a pair. A single speaker is not usable here.
Powered/active — has its own amplifier. Passive bookshelf speakers need a separate amp and don't qualify.

nice_to_have.test: Extra digital inputs for a TV or computer.

dealbreakers: No phono input and no way to add one
PA / DJ boxes — wrong category for a room vinyl setup

condition.note: Seller claiming it works is acceptable. Still flag 'untested', 'as-is', or 'for parts' prominently — powered speaker amps fail often.

fair_value.basis: New retail from Amazon/Best Buy Jul 2026, used FMV estimated at ~60% of new. Phase 3 should verify against sold listings.

known_negatives.reason: Line-level only — no phono stage. Confirmed.
Line/optical/coax only — verify phono per model, most Edifier powered pairs lack it.

unknown_model_fallback.note: If the model isn't listed, look up new retail and take 60%. Confirm phono input before scoring at all.
